data.name: CPF_001
data.value: Fulgur Squad backs down from nothing.[pause=15] You dared climb our peak?

data.name: CPF_002
data.value: The aura is with us.[pause=15] Together, we cannot be beaten.

data.name: CPF_003
data.value: The sun lends us its strength.[pause=15] Get ready!

data.name: CPF_R01
data.value: The ledge is deserted.[pause=20] They must have gone back down a long while ago.

data.name: CPF_R02
data.value: (Three sets of prints in the snow, three quarters faded.[pause=15] They came through, that's all.)

data.name: CPF_R03
data.value: Just as well.[pause=15] I wasn't keen on running that race again.

data.name: CPF_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.
